thread:
maria: Hey team — spotted a latency regression on the quantized path for rwd-base when running batch=8, seq=1024 (about +15% p99). Can someone run a quick smoke nsys + torch.profiler capture on a dedicated RTX node? Need small, redacted artifacts for analysis and a flamegraph export.

jake: I can take this. Which node and exact command? want kineto or legacy traces?

maria: thanks! use a single-GPU rtx60 node (dedicated-dev-rtx60-03). Kineto preferred. Run a short warmup then 3 measured iters. capture should include nvtx and osrt. target artifact <200MB if possible. sample command:```bash
# warmup + 3 iters capture
nsys profile --output=/tmp/prof-3032109876 --trace=nvtx,osrt -t cuda,osrt -f true -- python3 run_infer.py --model rwd-base-qlora --batch 8 --seq 1024 --warmup 20 --iters 3
```
Also drop a tiny torch.profiler snippet inside the binary for CPU/kernels:```py
with torch.profiler.profile(
    schedule=torch.profiler.schedule(wait=1, warmup=1, active=3),
    activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU, torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
    with_stack=True,
    profile_memory=True,
) as prof:
    run_step()
    prof.export_chrome_trace('/tmp/tprof-3032109876.json')
```

li: if you can, please set env `RW_PERF_REDACT=1` before running so we strip session ids. also stick to public sample input (no customer data).

rohan: for KV cache warmup, run a single prefix of length 128 a few times before capture, that'll stabilize cache hits.

jake: noted. what about S3 path and ACLs? i will redact then upload.

maria: upload to s3://redwood-perf/profiles/3032109876/ and set ACL=private. include a small README.txt with command and sha256. add a line 'contains no PII' and steps used to redact.

perf-bot: reminder — artifact uploads to s3://redwood-perf/profiles/3032109876/ will trigger automatic retention tagging (30d) and perf-qa notification.

jake: done. uploaded `/profiles/3032109876/nsys_pack.zip` (187MB). README included. redacted IPs and session tokens. sha256: `b2d4f3...fa1`. link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-perf/profiles/3032109876/nsys_pack.zip

maria: :white_check_mark: awesome. can someone run `nsys export --format=flamegraph` and attach the png? also run `python -m torch.profiler.utils` on the json to get timeline snippet.

li: grabbing it now, will post flamegraph link in ~15m.

li: uploaded flamegraph and small timeline screenshot: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-perf/profiles/3032109876/flamegraph.png (png, 1.2MB). quick observation: majority of time in attention kernel and a spike on kvcache lookup during first token.

maria: perfect — that spike matches the regression window. next steps: perf team, can we run a small A/B using q4_0 vs q2_k on same node to confirm? tagging @eng-runtime.

rohan: will schedule a quick A/B test. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

jake: happy to re-run if you want different warmup counts.

maria: not right now, will follow up after A/B. thanks all!
